title: The Windmill Turns
setup: Your rook on g2 blocks your own bishop's line to h1, and White's queen on c2 is guarded by a rook.
hint: The rook can leave with check and come straight back with check. Work out why g2 is a square White can never take.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxc2+}} takes the guarded queen, because leaving g2 uncovers the bishop's check from b7. {{Kg1}} is forced, and {{Rg2+}} returns at once: the king cannot capture, since the bishop covers g2, and f1 is blocked by White's own knight. The rook is untouchable, and the queen is gone for nothing.
